decision_scope.zh: 游戏历史分支不在本轮重新排名；声音明确保留V4人声，新增V4.1独立编排。
decision_scope.en: Historical game branches are not being re-ranked. V4 speech is retained; V4.1 is a separate arrangement.

voice_acceptance.zh: 教师已认可V4主体呈现；V4.1动物层次增强待试听。
voice_acceptance.en: The teacher accepted the core V4 presentation; richer V4.1 animal layers await listening.

scope.zh: 游戏与配音累计；配音曾单独授权不套课堂上限，完整账本未核齐。
scope.en: Cumulative game and voice work; voice production had a separate authorization. Full accounting is incomplete.

missing.zh: 缺历史主控/执行端API等值、教师工时与电费；不能把本地推理零API账单写成总成本零。
missing.en: Historical controller/executor usage, teacher time and electricity are missing. Zero local-inference API bills do not mean zero total cost.

scope.zh: 当前游戏展示＋声音管线与编排，一次重建的规划估算，不累加所有旧版。
scope.en: Planning estimate to rebuild the current game presentation and voice pipeline/arranger once, not a sum of every past version.

rate_basis.zh: 沿用已批准HUB的历史假设时薪；不是市场新报价或已付人工。
rate_basis.en: Historical assumed hourly rate from the approved HUB, not a current market quote or paid labour.

name.zh: 现有游戏呈现与资料整理
本地克隆、情绪与发音调试
轻量调音台、MIDI与版本管理

reason.zh: 同阶段真实时间与完整工具计量缺失，不给跨阶段节省倍数。
reason.en: Comparable recorded time and full tool usage are missing; no cross-stage savings multiple is claimed.

evidence.zh: 合作救回八只动物的课堂主题。
evidence.en: Classroom concept: rescue eight animals together.

evidence.zh: 故事、角色、合作规则与双语声音要求。
evidence.en: Story, roles, cooperation rules and bilingual voice requirements.

evidence.zh: 已有游戏版本与四幕声音管线。
evidence.en: Existing game editions and a working four-scene voice pipeline.

evidence.zh: 教师试听认可V4；明确动物层次的最后改进。
evidence.en: Teacher accepted V4 listening and requested richer animal layers.

evidence.zh: 保留原单设备游戏；新增私密配音包的实体iPad导入待测。
evidence.en: Original single-device game retained; private voice import on physical iPad is pending.

evidence.zh: Chromium/WebKit、双语页面与本地混音导出通过；实机另外验收。
evidence.en: Chromium/WebKit, bilingual pages and local mix exports passed; physical devices remain separate.

evidence.zh: V4.1动物试听、实体MIDI与iPad尚未验收。
evidence.en: V4.1 animal listening, physical MIDI and iPad are not yet accepted.

image_note.zh: 历史游戏截图，不冒充本轮新实机测试。
image_note.en: Historical gameplay capture, not a new physical-device test.

strength.zh: 同一设备轮流合作；八动物救援目标清楚。
strength.en: Shared-device turn-taking with a clear eight-animal rescue goal.

limit.zh: 本轮不重写玩法、不把克隆声音合入游戏；实体设备回归另记。
limit.en: No gameplay rewrite or cloned-voice merge in this release; physical regression is separate.

image_note.zh: 游戏已有故事美术，非新游戏截图。
image_note.en: Existing story artwork, not a new gameplay screenshot.

strength.zh: 本人情绪参考真实接入，双语四幕，害怕0.55/0.75对照。
strength.en: Real emotional references, four bilingual scenes, fear 0.55/0.75 A/B.

limit.zh: 教师指出动物层次还不够；原人声保留不重做。
limit.en: Teacher requested richer animal layers; speech stays unchanged.

image_note.zh: 调音台合成音演示截图，不包含学生声音。
image_note.en: Mixer screenshot using synthetic demo tones; no student voice.

status.zh: 新增独立模块 · 待试听

strength.zh: 八条动物轨、68个双语事件；声音可叠加、独听、编辑时间与力度。
strength.en: Eight animal tracks and 68 bilingual cues; layering, solo, timing and velocity controls.

limit.zh: 复用已有独立音效编排，不冒充八种动物的新情绪生成；硬件MIDI未测。
limit.en: Reuses independent effects, not eight newly generated emotional performances; hardware MIDI untested.

need.zh: Naomi的课堂作品：暴风雨前把小动物带回家。
need.en: Naomi’s classroom project: bring the animals home before a storm.

method.zh: 先确定角色、目标与共同成功条件，再实现回合规则。
method.en: Define roles, goals and shared success before implementing turns.

tech.zh: 浏览器游戏与独立规则逻辑。
tech.en: Browser game with separate rule logic.

result.zh: 形成同设备轮流合作的基础。

need.zh: 让障碍、森林网、勇气与回家目标更清楚。
need.en: Make obstacles, forest nets, courage and the home objective clearer.

method.zh: 课堂反馈→规则与美术修改→版本留存。
method.en: Classroom feedback → rule/art changes → version preservation.

tech.zh: JavaScript规则、场景呈现与历史截图。
tech.en: JavaScript rules, scene presentation and historical captures.

result.zh: 游戏形成可展示的救援闭环；不是本轮新通关。
result.en: Produced a demonstrable rescue loop, not a new playthrough this release.

need.zh: 花园派对、风雨、救援、团圆形成连贯故事。
need.en: Garden, storm, rescue and reunion become a coherent story.

method.zh: 分幕脚本、故事图、配音资源与触发流程整理。
method.en: Organize scene scripts, artwork, audio resources and triggers.

tech.zh: 已有故事模块与IndexTTS配音版本。
tech.en: Existing story module and IndexTTS narration edition.

result.zh: 后续本人声音替换有了明确脚本基线。
result.en: Created a clear script baseline for the later personal voice work.

title.zh: 合作探索与本人配音需求

need.zh: 课堂探索版与不同情绪的本人声音；速度可调、句尾稳定。
need.en: Classroom exploration and personal emotional speech, adjustable pace and stable endings.

method.zh: 核对coop-claude基线；保护参考录音，先试小样再试听。
method.en: Check the coop-claude baseline, protect references and compare small samples first.

tech.zh: 本地IndexTTS与MOSS分轨，Mac试听、GPU本地推理。
tech.en: Local IndexTTS and MOSS stems; private playback and local GPU inference.

result.zh: 游戏和私密声音候选保持独立。
result.en: Kept the game and private voice candidates separate.

title.zh: 参数传入，但表演过于克制

need.zh: 教师听到声音偏平，动物与环境音奇怪。
need.en: Teacher heard flat speech and awkward animal/environment effects.

method.zh: 审查真实生成参数、情绪权重、参考输入和混音时间线。
method.en: Audit actual generation parameters, emotion weights, references and the mix timeline.

tech.zh: QwenEmotion文字向量、低强度、统一减速与整段动物音。
tech.en: Text-emotion vectors, low intensity, global slowdown and grouped animal effects.

result.zh: 确定定向修改表演与编排，而不是推倒管线。
result.en: Target performance and arrangement instead of rebuilding the pipeline.

title.zh: 本人情绪参考真正进入生成

need.zh: 保持Naomi音色，增强起伏，同时能对照和回退。
need.en: Retain Naomi’s identity, add expression and preserve comparisons.

method.zh: 14条人声分段生成；害怕两档同种子对照；12条音效分开制作。
method.en: Generate 14 speech takes, controlled fear A/B and 12 separate effects.

tech.zh: IndexTTS 2.5参考/向量、原生时长控制；MOSS 2.0独立短素材。
tech.en: IndexTTS 2.5 reference/vector control and native timing; independent MOSS 2.0 effects.

result.zh: 教师认可主体效果，仅要求动物更丰富。
result.en: Teacher accepted the core result and requested richer animals.

title.zh: 从听故事，到做声音导演

need.zh: 动物叠加更丰富，保留调音与MIDI编排，并固定可复用技术栈。
need.en: Richer layers, editable MIDI-style arrangement and a pinned reusable stack.

method.zh: 原人声逐字节保留→八动物轨→68个事件→独立调音台→HUB与版本锁。
method.en: Preserve speech bytes → eight animal tracks → 68 cues → independent mixer → HUB and version lock.

tech.zh: Web Audio采样器、JSON编排、可选Web MIDI、本地WAV与口型包络导出。
tech.en: Web Audio sampler, JSON arrangements, optional Web MIDI, local WAV and mouth-envelope export.

result.zh: 声音模块独立呈现；尚未接入完整数字人或原游戏。
result.en: Separate voice module; not yet a full avatar or original-game integration.

text.zh: 项目记录：首次课堂2026-08-25；公开摘要不含姓氏和私人记录。
text.en: Project record: first class 2026-08-25; public summary excludes surname and private records.

text.en: Sanitized classroom brief and V2 requirement summary.

text.zh: 实际生成配置与混音脚本审计，私密音频不公开。
text.en: Actual parameter and mix-code audit; private audio is not published.

text.zh: V4交付核验与教师本轮试听反馈。
text.en: V4 delivery verification and current teacher listening feedback.

text.en: V4.1 local verification: eight animal tracks, 68 events, unchanged V4 speech.

disclaimer.zh: 作品观察与工程验收，不是学生成绩。未知成本与实机项目不填零、不填通过。
disclaimer.en: Work observations and engineering checks, not a student grade. Unknown costs and physical-device tests are not recorded as zero or passed.
